title: The two-cell lepton register on the sixty-address carrier, run over many rounds
map_into_this_step: The rest phase per tick is the expected number of exclusive reads per tick.

fields.status: "done", or "running: ..." with the parts that are still being computed.
fields.phase_limit: Limit of the executed phase per unit clock time for many ticks per unit clock time: Richardson extrapolation (100 phase(1000) - phase(100))/99 of two executed values.
fields.phase_against_ticks: One row per executed run. ticks_per_unit_clock_time: N, the number of rounds per unit of the declared clock; every round is one tick and one inverse tick of both cells, the kick exp(-i (1/N) J Qx) on the exclusive read of the record flags, the two return tests and the reset. phase_per_unit_clock_time: executed phase of the current j = +1 per unit clock time, all return tests yes; the complete record has the same phase. closed_form: N atan(P sin(1/N)/(1 - P + P cos(1/N))), P = 2/9. minus_2_9: phase - 2/9 (series -35/(2187 N^2)). executed_rounds: rounds of the run (at least 10^4). log_modulus: log of the kept modulus per unit clock time (series -7/(81 N)).
fields.executed_rates: Rest rates per unit of the register clock of the three characters of the face third-turn, from the executed mass rounds of the register on sixty addresses with native pairs and the oriented record. executed: minus the phase per unit clock, limit of many mass rounds. formula: (1/27)(1 + sqrt2 cos(2/9 + 2 pi k/3))^2. one_round: abs(<Phi|U|D D v_k>)^2 of one executed tick.
fields.gates: Reproduction of the numbers on file from the public package and from worker LC, exact arithmetic.
fields.run_by_elapsed_rounds: Per N: the running value of the phase per unit clock time after n executed rounds. It is flat: every round reads the first-tick count.
fields.limits: Richardson extrapolations of executed values at N and 10 N and their distance from 2/9.
fields.public_walk_run: The same round through Walk.step and Walk.inverse_step of the public package only, 10^4 rounds.
fields.complete_record: Every outcome of the return tests kept. outcome_weights: weights of the four test outcomes in the vector X of the round (exact). trajectories: sampled coherence of the clocked system between j = +1 and j = -1 after the given clock time, with standard error, and the exact value; resets per unit clock time.
fields.orderings: Alternative orderings, id as in CANDIDATES.md. value: executed phase per unit clock time. limit: its limit for many rounds. agrees_with_2_9: whether that limit is 2/9.
fields.forward_only: Control without the inverse tick, full two-load sector of a cell (18720 states). count_first_12[t-1]: exclusive count p + q - 2 p q at tick t.
fields.no_return_test: Control with the inverse tick and no return test: the angle after t units stays bounded.
fields.no_reset: Control with the return tests and no reset: mean count read by a round, every 100 rounds, exact from the four test states, with a sampled check.
fields.double_load_register: The same register with blank doubles and record flags: every rate is 5/4 of the formula (sum 5/18). Rows per lepton.
fields.mass_rounds: Executed rates against the number of mass rounds per unit of the register clock.
fields.with_executed_current: Ratios when the angle of the current inside the register tick is the one left by N_p executed rounds per unit clock time (2/9 - 35/(2187 N_p^2), modulus exp(-7/(81 N_p))).
fields.separation: Phase estimation with a clock register of T levels on the executed amplitudes. T counts units of the register clock. p_all_three_identified, p_muon_from_electron, p_tau_from_muon: probabilities of a correct call, equal priors. thresholds: smallest T that reaches the confidence (first) and smallest T from which it holds for every larger scanned T.
fields.circulation: A defect created at a definite position of the register, executed with the register explicit.
fields.comparison_not_blind: Executed ratios against CODATA 2022 and PDG 2024, read after the numbers were hashed.
fields.statements: Sentences for the page with label (EXACT, MEASURED, NOT BLIND, DECLARED) and status word.

executed_rates.standing_object: native pairs on two non-adjacent ports of each cell, oriented record
executed_rates.character_of: tau: trivial character; electron: winding w; muon: winding w^2

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: On sixty addresses a blank double reads blank 5/6, record 2 with 1/12, record 3 with 1/12 at each of the twelve ports. Two cells with independent registers read the exclusive count 2/9.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Executed over at least ten thousand rounds, the phase per unit clock time is 0.205334 for one round per tick, 0.222062 for ten and 0.2222222062 for a thousand. The limit of the executed values is 2/9 within 1e-13. Every round reads the count 2/9 within 2e-16.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: With every outcome of the return tests kept and the address register reset after a "no", the phase per unit clock time is the same. A "no" occurs 14/(81 N) times per unit clock time on a current branch.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Partners read one at a time with a shared kick give 2/9 for one, two, three and six partners. Partners read at once give 73/216 and 563/1296.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Controls. Without the inverse tick the count leaves 2/9 after the first tick (0.486, 0.536, 0.467), has no period and averages 0.4033 over ten thousand ticks. Without the return test the angle stays below 0.2898 for all times. Without the reset the count read tends to 1/2.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: The three characters of the face third-turn are the eigenvectors of the executed mass round. Their executed rest rates equal (1/27)(1 + sqrt2 cos(2/9 + 2 pi k/3))^2 within 1e-12 for native pairs and 5/4 of it for double loads. Ratios 206.770316 and 3477.4728.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: A clock register separates tau from muon at 99 percent in 28 units of the register clock and muon from electron in 441 units (native pairs, 1024 mass rounds per unit).

statements.label: NOT BLIND
statements.text: Compared after the numbers were fixed, with the angle 2/9: muon/electron +9.83 ppm against CODATA 2022, tau/electron +0.61 standard deviations against PDG 2024.

statements.label: DECLARED
statements.text: Open: what creates the pair on one port, the source event of the kick, the rule that reads one partner per unit clock time, the number of rounds per unit clock time, the lepton scale.

complete_record.multiplier: 1 - P + P exp(-i (j - j')/N) per round
complete_record.resets_per_unit_clock_time: N 4 sin^2(1/(2N)) 14/81 on a branch with abs(j) = 1
